# VeritasAI - Autonomous Real-Time Truth & Evidence Verification System

> VeritasAI is an autonomous truth verification research agent created by Adam Gierczak. Powered by NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory with real-time grounding via Tavily Search API.

## Core Capabilities
- Real-time fact inspection and claim verification
- Multi-source evidence grounding and hallucination reduction
- Synthetic confidence scoring (0-100%) and bias detection
- Structured verification dossiers and intelligence export

## Links and Resources
- [Main Application Console](https://veritas-io.netlify.app/): Live truth verification interface and interactive workspace.
- [Chat & Verification API](https://veritas-io.netlify.app/api/chat): Next.js Route Handler for agentic verification and claim inference.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/AdamBabinicz/veritas): Source code, system architecture, and deployment instructions.
- [Nebius Token Factory](https://studio.nebius.ai/): High-throughput cloud inference infrastructure running NVIDIA Nemotron models.
- [Tavily AI Search](https://tavily.com/): Real-time web search API optimized for LLMs and grounded claim validation.
